panels.title: Header
panels.content:
### Example
Controls + ES|QL panels from catalog.

panels.title: Access Denied Events
panels.esql: FROM logs-demo.events-* | WHERE user.email == ?username | WHERE error.code == "AccessDenied" | STATS count = COUNT(*)

panels.title: Top API Calls
panels.esql: FROM logs-demo.events-* | WHERE user.email == ?username | STATS count = COUNT(*) BY event.action | SORT count DESC | LIMIT 15

panels.title: Recent Activity
panels.esql: FROM logs-demo.events-* | WHERE user.email == ?username | KEEP @timestamp, event.action, source.ip | SORT @timestamp DESC | LIMIT 50
